summary: Phase 149O.20L.7E -- Dell Class-B Real Host Provisioning Independent Verification. Independent verification only -- no repair, redeployment, reconfiguration, certification, activation, or authority-broadening. Independently re-verified every claim in 7D.11's report from primary evidence over a fresh read-only ssh hac-dell session, not from 7D.11's own prose: machine identity (54ff22ce... exact), retained Actions 1-5, source-credential isolation, deployed SHA 28bf137b... exact match, detached/clean state, full 4108-path mode inventory (zero mismatches, not sampled), byte-identity for the complete 28-file HMIC canonical member set (not just the three previously-repaired files -- zero mismatches), the implementation_scope_digest (4e3452ba...) recomputed directly via the production function against Dell's real deployed tree and cross-checked via a disposable Mac worktree, HMIC contract identity (v1.3, byte-unchanged), certification/DeploymentBinding absence (Dell's trust-store registry directory is empty -- no registry file exists at all), venv path-binding, runtime import provenance, distribution identity (pcae-harness 0.2.0), wrapper digest/semantics (b3e969...c32, 188 bytes, 9 lines, exact), PATH trust topology (zero agent-writable components anywhere in the corrected-PATH chain), and two independent live Action-9 runs -- both deterministic, NON_COMPLIANT, failing set exactly {HBDC-REQ-042}; REQ-022/030/035/036 independently measured satisfied. Traced REQ-042 to its precise code-level cause (.pcae/repository-identity.json genuinely absent on Dell). Reconstructed the governing CHGR (chgr-0e37ed1340b14311826722c4dbf3e856) and both historical CHGRs directly from their own text -- neither historical CHGR names the candidate SHA (D3-3 carried forward unchanged). Independently verified pcae privilege isolation (no sudo, nologin, cannot read deploy credential), no project onboarding, Permission Broker still simulation-only, runtime unchanged. Final verdict: INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED BOUNDARY-P PROVISIONING; Class-B blocked solely by absent DeploymentBinding; HMIC source identity NOT CERTIFIED FOR BOUNDARY C; no Boundary C/A begun. Independently determined the next required step from primary architecture: DeploymentBinding architecture/design (no creation mechanism exists yet in the codebase).
